column3: Israel is made the one going to seek rest rather than the recipient of rest given.
“Take up” renders adorning oneself with tambourines.
The place of return, “here,” is not explicit.
“Had overpowered” renders being stronger than him.
“Abundantly” generalizes fatness; the people’s being satisfied is recast as God filling them.
“They are no more” renders a singular expression of absence.
“Disciplined me severely” combines active and passive forms of discipline.
“Keep ... in mind” renders setting the heart on the highway.
“Restore them from captivity” renders turning back their captivity.
